author: Gmelin, 1789
status: 여름철새 10만 마리 이상 · 나그네새 수만 마리 · 텃새 수천 마리
summary: 봄과 가을에 한반도 전역을 지나가는 나그네새로, 숲에서 번식한다. 이동할 때는 많은 수가 무리 지어 다니지만 겨울에는 혼자 있을 때가 많고, 여름에는 암수가 함께 지낸다. 땅에서 그리 높지 않은 나뭇가지에 둥지를 틀고 6월경에 알을 4~5개 낳는다. 장미과·포도과 등 식물의 씨앗과 곤충, 거미, 다족류 등을 먹는다.

points.en: white chin, grey cheeks and throat
lower mandible yellow at the base, brown tip

sexes.male: 머리꼭대기가 올리브색 띤 석판 잿빛이고, 뺨과 귀깃, 멱이 잿빛이다.
sexes.female: 머리꼭대기에서 위꽁지덮깃까지 수컷보다 붉은 기가 조금 적은 올리브 갈색으로, 머리와 등의 색 차이가 없다.

art.subject: Pale Thrush (Turdus pallidus), adult male (no spring moult, so the plumage is the same on spring and autumn passage): crown and nape slate-grey with an olive tinge; lores and eye surround dark grey; chin white; cheeks, ear-coverts and throat grey; mantle, back and wings plain olive-brown; upper breast and breast sides olive grey-brown; flanks pale pinkish-brown; centre of the belly and the undertail coverts white; tail dark grey-brown, the outer feathers with broad white tips; upper mandible and tip of the lower mandible brown, base of the lower mandible yellow; brown eye; pale yellowish legs.
art.pose: perched on a low branch near the ground, side view
art.scene: Korean woodland during spring or autumn passage, low branches above the forest floor; no people, buildings or text
views: adult male, side view perched on a low branch: slate-grey crown, grey face and throat, white chin, olive-brown back and wings, olive grey-brown breast, pale pinkish-brown flanks, white belly centre, white tail corners, yellow legs

adult female, side view perched: olive-brown head and back with no contrast between them, whitish throat with dark streaks at the sides, pale brown breast and flanks, white belly centre, white tail corners
adult, head detail in side profile: brown upper mandible, lower mandible yellow at the base with a brown tip, white chin against the grey throat, dark grey lores
art.build: Medium-sized thrush, about 23cm: a little shorter than a Brown-eared Bulbul, plumper and shorter-tailed. Rounded head; stands upright on the ground and often flicks its tail. Bill straight, slightly shorter than the head. Legs medium length, pale. At rest the wingtips reach about the base of the tail. Tail medium length, square-ended, dark with conspicuous white corners that flash when the bird flies or fans its tail. Shy; feeds among leaf litter and flies up to low branches when disturbed.
avoid: Do not paint a white supercilium; that is Eyebrowed Thrush.
Do not paint bright orange flanks; that is Grey-backed or Brown-headed Thrush. The flanks are only pale pinkish-brown.
Do not paint a spotted breast.
Do not leave out the white tips on the outer tail feathers.
